title: Affine lifting of a free complex with its supplied unit coefficient
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, S=Spec R [def-weil-affine-spectrum], P a cochain complex [def-pc-derived-category] of O_S-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and n:Z→N. Supply identifications e_j:P^j≅O_S^{n(j)} [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Fix i and basis indices p in degree i and q in degree i+1 such that the (q,p) coefficient of e_{i+1}d^ie_i^{-1} is a unit of Γ(S,O_S). There exist a chain complex C of R-modules, m:Z→N, finite bases b_k indexed by Fin(m(k)), and indices p′ in degree -i and q′ in degree -i-1, such that m(-j)=n(j), the (q′,p′) coefficient of d_C at -i is a unit, and isomorphisms φ_j:tilde(C_{-j})≅P^j [lem-weil-pbc-spec-tilde-free-module] with φ_k∘tilde(d_C(-j,-k))=d_P(j,k)∘φ_j for every adjacent j,k. This lifts the original complex; it does not assert cancellation or a homotopy equivalent complement.

proof.text: Take C_k to be the finitely supported functions on the ULift basis in degree -k, with m(k)=n(-k). Use tildeFinsupp and e_{-k}^{-1} to identify its associated sheaf with P^{-k}. Fullness lifts each conjugated differential, and faithfulness transfers the shape and square-zero identities. These give a chain complex; double negation gives m(-j)=n(j).

Reindex the standard ULift bases by Fin. The coproduct comparison defining tildeFinsupp preserves the standard injections and coordinate projections. The global-sections isomorphism ΓSpecIso then identifies the displayed freeMatrix coefficient with the module coefficient. A ring isomorphism preserves units, so the supplied pivot indices give the unit entry of C. The sheaf identifications intertwine the differentials by the defining preimage equation. This comparison works without a nontriviality hypothesis.
